title: Right to Demand Production of Documents

content.scenario: A consumer, Mr. Kumar, files a complaint against a company for selling him a defective air conditioner. During the investigation, Mr. Kumar demands to see the company's records and documents related to the manufacturing and testing of the air conditioner. The company is required to produce these documents to support their claim that the product was manufactured and tested according to standards.
content.outcome: The company produces the requested documents, which reveal that the air conditioner was indeed defective due to a manufacturing flaw, supporting Mr. Kumar's complaint and leading to a resolution in his favor.
